about: T-3226 (AG-118): every platform workflow the owner named, asked in Slovak and English of Helsinki's internal assistant `knowledge` once its sources hold the User Guide (`source: guide`). An answer passes when it is in the asker's language, cites only the Portal (every [n] resolved), and links the form of the workflow (`form`, the Portal page the guide section in `section` cites, rewritten to the asker's project). Recorded once on dev after the guide source is deployed (recordings/helsinki-workflows.json).
